readings.Aries: Your energy is a resource, not a personality trait. Spend it deliberately today. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Taurus: Stubbornness and consistency are the same trait in different lighting. Today, which one is it? Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Gemini: The quickest path through this is honesty, which will feel slow at first. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Cancer: Something you offered freely is being taken for granted. You noticed. Say something. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Leo: The warmth you've been rationing — release it. You have more than enough. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Virgo: Your analytical nature is a form of love — you take things seriously enough to understand them. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Libra: Someone is asking you to take their side. You are stalling. At some point stalling is a choice. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Scorpio: What you call jealousy is a diagnostic tool for what you care about most. Use it accordingly. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Sagittarius: Your faith that things will work out is usually warranted. Today, pair it with a concrete step. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Capricorn: Something you've built together with someone else is worth tending to. Not as a project. As a relationship. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Aquarius: Your independence is real and it is also sometimes used to avoid being vulnerable. Notice that today. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Pisces: The mood that comes in like water recedes like water too. Stay with it until it does. Act from the calmest part of yourself.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
